cloud_computer_managed: Runs on openTag Cloud, managed by the platform
cloud_progress_save_failed: Some execution progress could not be saved. Affected conversations may be paused. Contact your administrator for help. Do not resend completed requests.
cloud_recovery_changed: This conversation now has a different environment. Status has been refreshed; select it again before continuing.
cloud_recovery_description: Advanced recovery tools for guided troubleshooting. Saving and releasing stops the selected conversation’s current work and releases its environment only after the files are saved. A later message can restore the latest saved state. Do not repeat completed external actions.
cloud_recovery_discard_description: Changes since the last successful save will be permanently lost. This stops the conversation’s current work and releases its environment while keeping the previous archive. Completed external actions are not undone.
cloud_recovery_read_failed: Workspace status could not be read. Refresh before attempting recovery.
cloud_recovery_save_description: This conversation may have running or queued work. Saving and releasing interrupts its current execution and releases the environment only after files are saved. Do not repeat completed external actions.
cloud_recovery_saving: Saving and releasing. This can take several minutes.
cloud_recovery_status_unavailable: The recovery result and current status could not be confirmed. Refresh status before trying again.
cloud_recovery_uncertain: The recovery result could not be confirmed. Current status has been refreshed. Review it before trying again; the request was not automatically repeated.
